purpose: Compare multiple numeric series across categories.

rawDataContract.notes: Rows may be wide or tidy. The model chooses category and grouped numeric fields.

payloadShape.title: string
payloadShape.financialMarket: CN | HK | US (optional; controls financial up/down colors)

barPlaceholders.series: exact missing target field or unique label
barPlaceholders.referenceSeries: exact other series in the same row, with finite value
barPlaceholders.label: localized status, e.g. 尚未公布

modelInstructions: In Mentora use the existing source JSON file via payload.dataSource.path/recordsPath/fields instead of copying rows or writing a conversion script for simple field/date mappings. Read hostExtensions.dataSource for the exact contract; run this concrete script through skill_runner.py execute.
Use when grouped comparison matters more than time trend.
For financial direction charts set financialMarket explicitly: CN and HK use red-up/green-down; US uses green-up/red-down. Bars, legends, and tooltips must use the same convention.
Keep grouped series count small enough for readable bars.
Default x-axis and y-axis tick labels should use 10px font size, matching bar-line charts.
Place x-axis labels close to the x-axis baseline; default label baseline offset should be around 20px below the plot area, not the older 26px spacing.

X-axis labels should be displayed in full when measured label widths fit without overlap; only sample labels when full display would overlap, and sample by measured text width plus a small gap instead of fixed first/middle/last rules.
Hide the legend when the normalized payload contains only one series; show it by default for two or more series.
When shown, legend styling should match bar-line charts: 10px text, 8px circular markers, compact row gaps, and labels only.
Include a y-axis description when the metric name is available; use axis.label/title/name/description and place it above the right or left y-axis ticks.

For right-side y-axes, align the y-axis description to the same right edge as the y-axis tick labels, and allow the description text to extend leftward into the chart area instead of reserving extra right margin.
Tooltip should sit near the first gridline but not too high; use a compact vertical gap around 10px.
Do not add viewport or screen safety margins inside the component; component padding and default left/right plot margins should be zero unless needed for axis tick labels or explicit user styling.
Right-axis tick labels should be measured and right-aligned close to the plot with a small plot-to-label gap.

Choose axis bounds from the actual finite data and the zero baseline, then place gridCount horizontal lines including the zero baseline (default five total lines); use one equal interval across the ticks with zero included; tiny opposite-sign values stay inside the domain without creating an extra grid line. A tiny value across zero must not create a large empty band. Keep measured first/last category labels completely inside the SVG while sampling crowded labels.

For an explicitly requested missing/unreported bar placeholder, use barPlaceholders with exact series, x (or index), referenceSeries and localized label. The renderer draws a transparent diagonal hatch and outline from zero to the same-row reference value, preserving the missing target as null; tooltip and legend identify it as a placeholder. Never fill the actual field with its estimate or zero, never use placeholders for existing values, and never invent an unavailable reference. Negative references are supported. Missing bars without an explicit placeholder are omitted and shown as — in tooltip. This is a native grouped_bar.py feature; do not route to custom HTML/StreamViz for hatched placeholders.

dataSource.purpose: Pass a verified local JSON file directly; the host maps fields and checks rendered values without model transcription.
dataSource.payload: Keep normal renderer fields (xField, series/yField, axes, visualStyle). Omit data/rows when dataSource is used. No scaling or filling is performed.
dataSource.pieMapping: For pie.py map source fields to label/value; nonnegative finite values and positive total required. Missing values must be handled explicitly upstream, never silently zero-filled.
dataSource.lineOptions: xScale=time for irregular ISO dates/epoch ms; visualStyle.line.curve=step-after|step-before|straight|smooth; missingValuePolicy=gap preserves nulls.
dataSource.receipt: chartValidation reports source hash, rows, per-series valid/missing counts, min/max, first/last observations and axis coverage. Verified chart HTML can be passed to StreamViz chart_artifacts without copying data or drawing SVG coordinates.

hostExtensions.standalone: Direct component CLI still receives ordinary data; host expands dataSource before execution.
